title: Minimum Independent Witness Set Solver
canonical_question: Given candidate cause classes and an admissible test catalog with costs, dependencies and failure domains, what is the minimum additional witness set that makes the requested cause-class partition identifiable under the declared measurement model?

input_contract.cause_classes: Cause ids with optional target_class. Causes sharing target_class need not be separated when only class recovery is requested.

tests.distinguishes: explicit cause-id pairs the witness can separate under the declared model
tests.depends_on: prerequisite witnesses/tests; dependency closure is charged exactly once
tests.failure_domains: declared latent failure/provenance domains used by the independence gate
tests.available: false means counterfactual/planning-only and excluded from exact selectable sets

input_contract.already_acquired: sunk-cost witnesses already available to the inference problem

requirements.required_independent_separators_per_pair: minimum failure-mode-independent separators required for each rival cause pair
requirements.unknown_independence_conflicts: when true, missing failure-domain metadata cannot be used to claim redundant independence
requirements.max_exact_tests: hard exact-search ceiling; exceeding it yields UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT rather than a fake minimum

exactness_rule.small_problem: For decision-test count <= max_exact_tests, every selectable subset is considered after dependency closure and duplicate closure elimination; minimum is exact under the supplied binary discrimination and independence model.
exactness_rule.large_problem: For decision-test count > max_exact_tests, verdict = UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT. Any ranking is heuristic planning information only and is not called a minimum proof.

independence_rule.pairwise: Two witnesses count as failure-mode independent only when their declared failure_domains are disjoint.
independence_rule.unknown_metadata: With unknown_independence_conflicts=true, an untagged witness cannot create a second independent confirmation merely because it is a separate record.
independence_rule.shared_lineage_warning: Different files, scans, models or instruments may still be dependent when they share a latent provenance or processing failure domain.

verdicts.IDENTIFIABILITY_CANDIDATE: An exact minimum witness set exists under the declared planning model; this is not empirical proof that the discrimination edges are scientifically correct.
verdicts.NON_IDENTIFIABLE_UNDER_CURRENT_MEASUREME: All admissible exact subsets were evaluated and at least one rival pair remains unresolved.
verdicts.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: The exact-search ceiling was exceeded; silence or heuristic failure is not negative evidence.

validation_plan.synthetic_known_minimum: Must recover a predeclared exact minimum and cost.
validation_plan.cross_domain_search_proof: Must recover an exact minimum in a non-optical operational domain.
validation_plan.palomar_real_world_structured_replay: Must preserve unresolved historical-origin ambiguity rather than force a cause when current admissible deterministic witnesses do not separate all remaining classes.

provenance.preservation_rule: Future R4.x revisions must supersede this contract and preserve failed/negative replay receipts.
